name: core--prometheus-dns-scrape
description: Prometheus scrape targets use Docker service names instead of DNS hostnames

implementation.change: Replace DNS hostnames (e.g., litellm.local) with Docker service names (litellm, headroom, qdrant)

checks: No .local or .com DNS names in scrape_configs

disabled_reason: Superseded by eval 010 (prometheus-dns-hostnames): DNS approach (litellm.local.koeff.com) required for cross-network Prometheus scraping. Docker service names only work within container network.
